Scott County Auditor Kerri Tompkins announces important dates for the upcoming November 3 General Election. “Please plan ahead so you can be sure to cast your ballot,” says Tompkins.
Posted: Monday, October 12, 2026
First Day to Submit Request for Absentee Ballots for the November 3 General Election
Scott County Auditor Kerri Tompkins announced that Tuesday, August 25 is the first day for voters to submit requests for absentee ballots by mail for the November 3 General Election. You must request an absentee ballot to receive a ballot via the mail. Ballots will begin to be mailed on October 14...
